title: Uniform Fourier basis on the sign set
statement: The real-valued functions on $\{\pm1\}$ have a basis indexed by $\{0,1\}$ whose vector at index $0$ is the constant function $1$. With respect to the uniform probability distribution on $\{\pm1\}$, the basis vectors are orthonormal: the expectation of the product of the vectors at indices $a$ and $b$ is $1$ if $a=b$ and $0$ otherwise.
